name: Full Smile
verdict: Strong efficiency gains this week: CPL dropped 20.44% week-over-week while leads grew 6.9%, driven by the top Meta campaign "BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness" ($798.37 spend) delivering more volume at lower cost despite a 14.96% pullback in spend. The biggest watch item is GBP activity falling 51.92%, suggesting reduced organic discovery that could pressure lead volume if paid spend continues to decline.

performance.verdict: Meta efficiency is real, but spend erosion and 10 overdue SOW items threaten August scoreboard.

findings.text: 10 SOW milestones overdue (oldest: 2025-07-23 renewal closure); 4 are CRM/attribution blockers that directly break the Aug scoreboard lead-to-patient tracking chain.

CPL improved 20.44% WoW to ~$11.80 (28d avg) on Meta, but last-3-day spend collapsed to $18.49, $21.11, $42.59 vs prior-3-day $64.90, $62.78, $73.08 — efficiency gains risk reversing if budget keeps eroding.
Last-3-day leads: 1, 1, 4 vs prior-3-day 8, 4, 8 — a confirmed volume deceleration signal inside a 45-day range of 2–10/day, directly tied to the spend drop.
GBP actions fell 51.92% WoW; last 2 days logged 0 GBP actions each, vs a 45-day peak of 16 — organic discovery collapsing while paid also contracts is a compounding volume risk.

GHL shows 125 leads and 75 opportunities created (28d) but 0 appointments recorded and 0 won opps — leads are entering the pipeline but intake conversion to booked appointment is not being tracked or is broken.

suggestions.text: Triage the 4 CRM/attribution overdue milestones (phone-match, OD patient groups, doctor hours, dashboard) before Aug 31 scoreboard review.
suggestions.monday_update: Four overdue milestones — phone-match attribution (Aug 7), OD patient groups Lily sit-down (Aug 14), doctor hours in GHL calendars (Aug 14), and the lead-to-patient dashboard (Aug 31) — are unresolved and directly break the client's scoreboard. GHL currently shows 0 appointments and 0 won opportunities against 75 created opps over 28 days; without these fixes, Flow cannot demonstrate the lead→schedule→show→patient chain the client is judging us on. Success check: all 4 items marked complete in Monday with evidence (screenshot or sync log) by Aug 22, before the next biweekly Lily sync.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta daily budget to ~$65/day (+20% from current ~$50.92/day run rate) to arrest the 3-day lead volume collapse.
suggestions.monday_update: Spend dropped to an average of $18.49–$42.59/day over the last 3 days, causing leads to fall to 1–4/day against a 45-day range of 2–10/day. CPL is at a 28-day best of $11.80, so the campaign is efficient right now — this is the right time to hold or modestly restore volume, not pull back. Raise the BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness campaign daily budget to approximately $65/day (roughly +20% above the 7-day average of $50.92). Success check: leads return to 4+ per day within 3 days (by Aug 19) without CPL exceeding $15.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 actions on Aug 14–15; if 0 persists through Aug 19, escalate as an organic discovery outage.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions are down 51.92% WoW and logged 0 on each of the last 2 recorded days (Aug 14–15), against a 45-day peak of 16 actions/day. This is not yet confirmed as a structural problem — weekend suppression or a data lag could explain 2 zero-days. Re-check on Aug 19: if actions remain at or near 0 for 5 consecutive days, escalate to GBP/SEO team as a listing health or category issue. No paid action warranted until confirmed.
